arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc, c.description, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count, COUNT(*) AS labelled_count, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description HAVING SUM(f.is_fraud) >= 50 ORDER BY fraud_rate DESC, m.mcc
arguments.explanation: Lists each MCC with at least 50 fraud-labelled transactions, with its fraud rate over labelled transactions, sorted from highest to lowest rate.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only (inner join to fraud_labels), as fraud count divided by labelled transaction count.
MCC is taken from the merchant of each transaction (transactions.merchant_id -> merchants.mcc -> mcc_codes).
'At least 50 transactions labelled as fraud' means is_fraud = 1 count >= 50 per MCC.
Data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31; no date filter applied.
